verdict.rationale: DPMA's online filing and register services could plausibly offer a test environment, so this story applies to the product. However, the evidence documents no sandbox or test environment kept separate from live filings or register data. The DPMAdirektPro note about validating application documents is local document validation, not an isolated sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
